page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m8-vws.2xlarge is a KVM-hypervised virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.vgn6i-vws family. It features 10 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 5 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 46.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.6 GB per core. For accelerated workloads, it includes a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU providing 8 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, operating with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core CPU performance is weak, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1110.19 and a Geekbench single-core score of 913.0. Multi-core performance is average, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 7390.5 and a PassMark CPU score of 8589.71. Memory bandwidth is average, reaching 48.09 GB/sec for large block reads, though PassMark memory performance is weak. For specialized tasks, the instance achieves average scores in ray tracing, image processing, and software compilation, but performs poorly in single-threaded gzip compression and medium-sized LLM inference.

Given the inclusion of a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU and dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs, this instance offers a cost-efficient entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads that do not require a full dedicated GPU. The resource density is suitable for entry-level deep learning inference, light graphics rendering, virtual workstations, and general-purpose workloads requiring moderate parallel processing. However, the lack of local storage and weak single-core performance make it less suitable for high-frequency trading or disk-heavy database operations.

Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this instance lacks local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.
